# Confidential virtual machine

This submodule deploys Azure Confidential Virtual Machines and their network interfaces.

It supports Linux and Windows, optional managed data disks and attachments, managed identities,
and optional Azure Backup protection through an existing Recovery Services vault policy.
It uses AzureRM for these resources and AzAPI for its telemetry deployment.

Prefer the [root pattern module](../../README.md) when you need shared location and tag defaults.
When calling this submodule directly:

- Set `location` inside every VM definition. The separate module-level `location` is used only for telemetry and does not default VM locations.
- Supply existing resource groups and subnets, plus a compatible confidential VM image, size, region, and quota.
- Provide either a password or SSH public key for Linux and a password for Windows. Protect state containing passwords.
- Data disks inherit VM tags unless disk tags are supplied; tags may be omitted at both levels.
  Disk tags replace VM tags, including an explicit empty map. Disk zones must be set independently of VM zones.
- Supply an existing vault and VM backup policy to enable backup. Include/exclude LUN sets are mutually exclusive
  and must reference data disks declared on the same VM.
- Use an Enhanced (`V2`) backup policy when the VM configuration requires it, as in the backup-enabled example.
  This submodule associates the supplied policy ID; it does not create or convert policies.
  For daily/weekly Enhanced policies, explicitly configure instant-restore retention shorter than vaulted retention.
- Configure providers in the calling Terraform root. No public IP address, network security group,
  resource group, virtual network, subnet, vault, or policy is created by this submodule.

Outputs use the VM keys from `confidential_virtual_machines`; disk outputs additionally use each VM's data-disk keys.
Backup outputs contain only protected VMs. Principal IDs are meaningful only for system-assigned identities.

Telemetry defaults to enabled and requires module-level `location` and subscription-scoped deployment permissions.
Set `enable_telemetry = false` to disable the empty telemetry deployment; this does not remove per-VM location requirements.

## Optional Inputs

The following input variables are optional (have default values):

### <a name="input_confidential_virtual_machines"></a> [confidential\_virtual\_machines](#input\_confidential\_virtual\_machines)

Description: Map of confidential virtual machine definitions.

Keys identify VM instances and must be known at plan time. Values are objects:

- `name` - (Required) Name of the virtual machine.
- `location` - (Required) Azure region where the virtual machine and NIC are created.
- `resource_group_name` - (Required) Existing resource group name for the VM, NIC, and data disks.
- `subnet_resource_id` - (Required) Subnet resource ID used by the primary NIC IP configuration.
- `source_image_reference` - (Required) Source image reference for the virtual machine.
  - `publisher` - (Required) Image publisher.
  - `offer` - (Required) Image offer.
  - `sku` - (Required) Confidential-compute-compatible image SKU.
  - `version` - (Required) Image version or `latest`.
- `os_type` - (Optional) VM operating system type: `Linux` or `Windows`. Defaults to `Linux`.
- `zone` - (Optional) Availability zone for the virtual machine.
- `size` - (Optional) VM size. Defaults to `Standard_DC2as_v5`.
- `admin_username` - (Optional) Admin username. Defaults to `azureuser`.
- `admin_password` - (Optional) Admin password. Required for Windows. Optional for Linux when SSH key is provided.
- `admin_ssh_public_key` - (Optional) SSH public key for Linux.
- `secure_boot_enabled` - (Optional) Enable secure boot. Defaults to `true`.
- `vtpm_enabled` - (Optional) Enable vTPM. Defaults to `true`.
- `private_ip_address` - (Optional) Private IP for the primary NIC IP configuration. Supplying a value forces static allocation.
- `private_ip_address_allocation` - (Optional) `Dynamic` or `Static`. Defaults to `Dynamic`.
- `network_interface_name` - (Optional) NIC name. Defaults to `<name>-nic`.
- `accelerated_networking_enabled` - (Optional) Whether accelerated networking is enabled on the NIC. Defaults to `false`.
- `computer_name` - (Optional) OS hostname; when omitted, the provider uses the VM name subject to OS naming constraints.
- `identity_type` - (Optional) Managed identity type: `SystemAssigned`, `UserAssigned`, or `SystemAssigned, UserAssigned`. Defaults to `SystemAssigned`.
- `user_assigned_identity_resource_ids` - (Optional) User assigned identity IDs, only used when `identity_type` includes `UserAssigned`.
- `tags` - (Optional) Tags applied to VM and NIC resources.
- `backup_configuration` - (Optional) Azure Backup protection configuration for the VM:
  - `recovery_vault_resource_group_name` - (Required) Resource group name of the Recovery Services vault.
  - `recovery_vault_name` - (Required) Name of the Recovery Services vault.
  - `backup_policy_resource_id` - (Required) Compatible backup policy resource ID to associate with the VM. Use an Enhanced (`V2`) policy when required by the VM configuration. For daily/weekly Enhanced policies, explicitly configure instant-restore retention shorter than vaulted retention. The module does not create or convert policies.
  - `include_disk_luns` - (Optional) Declared data-disk LUNs to include in backup. Mutually exclusive with `exclude_disk_luns`.
  - `exclude_disk_luns` - (Optional) Declared data-disk LUNs to exclude from backup. Mutually exclusive with `include_disk_luns`.
- `data_disks` - (Optional) Map of additional managed data disks (zero to many) created and attached to the VM:
  - `name` - (Optional) Managed disk name. Defaults to `<vm-name>-<disk-key>`.
  - `lun` - (Required) Data disk LUN between 0 and 63, unique within this VM.
  - `disk_size_gb` - (Required) Data disk size in GB.
  - `storage_account_type` - (Optional) Storage SKU. Defaults to `Premium_LRS`.
  - `caching` - (Optional) Host caching mode (`None`, `ReadOnly`, `ReadWrite`). Defaults to `ReadWrite`.
  - `zone` - (Optional) Availability zone for the managed disk. Does not inherit the VM zone.
  - `disk_encryption_set_id` - (Optional) Disk encryption set resource ID.
  - `write_accelerator_enabled` - (Optional) Enables write accelerator on the attachment. Defaults to `false`.
  - `tags` - (Optional) Tags for the data disk resource, replacing VM tags when supplied. Inherits VM tags when omitted; may be omitted at both levels.
- `os_disk` - (Optional) Confidential OS disk options:
  - `caching` - (Optional) OS disk caching type. Defaults to `ReadWrite`.
  - `storage_account_type` - (Optional) OS disk storage account type. Defaults to `Premium_LRS`.
  - `disk_size_gb` - (Optional) OS disk size in GB.
  - `security_encryption_type` - (Optional) Confidential OS disk encryption type: `VMGuestStateOnly` or `DiskWithVMGuestState`. Defaults to `DiskWithVMGuestState`.
  - `secure_vm_disk_encryption_set_id` - (Optional) Disk encryption set resource ID for confidential disk encryption with customer-managed keys.

Type:

```hcl
map(object({
    name                = string
    location            = string
    resource_group_name = string
    subnet_resource_id  = string
    source_image_reference = object({
      publisher = string
      offer     = string
      sku       = string
      version   = string
    })

    os_type                             = optional(string, "Linux")
    zone                                = optional(string, null)
    size                                = optional(string, "Standard_DC2as_v5")
    admin_username                      = optional(string, "azureuser")
    admin_password                      = optional(string, null)
    admin_ssh_public_key                = optional(string, null)
    secure_boot_enabled                 = optional(bool, true)
    vtpm_enabled                        = optional(bool, true)
    private_ip_address                  = optional(string, null)
    private_ip_address_allocation       = optional(string, "Dynamic")
    network_interface_name              = optional(string, null)
    accelerated_networking_enabled      = optional(bool, false)
    computer_name                       = optional(string, null)
    identity_type                       = optional(string, "SystemAssigned")
    user_assigned_identity_resource_ids = optional(set(string), [])
    tags                                = optional(map(string), null)
    backup_configuration = optional(object({
      recovery_vault_resource_group_name = string
      recovery_vault_name                = string
      backup_policy_resource_id          = string
      include_disk_luns                  = optional(set(number), null)
      exclude_disk_luns                  = optional(set(number), null)
    }), null)
    data_disks = optional(map(object({
      name                      = optional(string, null)
      lun                       = number
      disk_size_gb              = number
      storage_account_type      = optional(string, "Premium_LRS")
      caching                   = optional(string, "ReadWrite")
      zone                      = optional(string, null)
      disk_encryption_set_id    = optional(string, null)
      write_accelerator_enabled = optional(bool, false)
      tags                      = optional(map(string), null)
    })), {})
    os_disk = optional(object({
      caching                          = optional(string, "ReadWrite")
      storage_account_type             = optional(string, "Premium_LRS")
      disk_size_gb                     = optional(number, null)
      security_encryption_type         = optional(string, "DiskWithVMGuestState")
      secure_vm_disk_encryption_set_id = optional(string, null)
    }), {})
  }))
```

Default: `{}`

### <a name="input_enable_telemetry"></a> [enable\_telemetry](#input\_enable\_telemetry)

Description: This variable controls whether or not telemetry is enabled for the module.  
For more information see <https://aka.ms/avm/telemetryinfo>.  
If it is set to false, then no telemetry will be collected.

Type: `bool`

Default: `true`

### <a name="input_location"></a> [location](#input\_location)

Description: Azure region for this submodule's telemetry deployment only. Required when telemetry is enabled. Does not default the required location inside each VM definition.

Type: `string`

Default: `null`

## Outputs

The following outputs are exported:

### <a name="output_backup_protected_vm_ids"></a> [backup\_protected\_vm\_ids](#output\_backup\_protected\_vm\_ids)

Description: Resource IDs of Azure Backup protected-item associations for confidential virtual machines.

### <a name="output_data_disk_attachment_resource_ids"></a> [data\_disk\_attachment\_resource\_ids](#output\_data\_disk\_attachment\_resource\_ids)

Description: Resource IDs of data disk attachments for confidential virtual machines, grouped by VM key and data-disk key.

### <a name="output_data_disk_resource_ids"></a> [data\_disk\_resource\_ids](#output\_data\_disk\_resource\_ids)

Description: Resource IDs of managed data disks for confidential virtual machines, grouped by VM key and data-disk key.

### <a name="output_network_interface_resource_ids"></a> [network\_interface\_resource\_ids](#output\_network\_interface\_resource\_ids)

Description: Resource IDs of network interfaces created for confidential virtual machines.

### <a name="output_resource_ids"></a> [resource\_ids](#output\_resource\_ids)

Description: Resource IDs of confidential virtual machines.

### <a name="output_resource_names"></a> [resource\_names](#output\_resource\_names)

Description: Resource names of confidential virtual machines.

### <a name="output_system_assigned_identity_principal_ids"></a> [system\_assigned\_identity\_principal\_ids](#output\_system\_assigned\_identity\_principal\_ids)

Description: System-assigned managed identity principal IDs keyed by VM key. Only meaningful for VMs with a system-assigned identity.

### <a name="output_virtual_machine_private_ip_addresses"></a> [virtual\_machine\_private\_ip\_addresses](#output\_virtual\_machine\_private\_ip\_addresses)

Description: Primary private IP addresses for confidential virtual machines.
